issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 11.6% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Cleveland, OH plant pays an average 11.6% premium above best plant pricing for 237 materials sourced from Meridian Industrial US in SAP ECC 6.0, resulting in $3,729,867 excess spend over the trailing 12 months. Root cause is lack of price harmonization across plants, allowing localized procurement to operate outside corporate agreements with different pricing terms for identical materials.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct emergency price benchmark analysis in SAP to identify the 237 materials and document best plant prices vs. Cleveland pricing for Meridian Industrial US across all material masters

Negotiate consolidated corporate agreement with Meridian Industrial US to extend best-plant pricing (11.6% reduction) to Cleveland plant for all 237 materials, leveraging combined volume across facilities

Update SAP ECC 6.0 info records (ME11/ME12) and outline agreements (ME31K/ME32K) for all 237 materials at Cleveland plant to reflect harmonized pricing; implement source list (ME01) mandating Meridian as sole supplier at new rates
Block all legacy Cleveland-specific purchasing info records and local agreements in SAP (deletion flag via ME12) to prevent reversion to premium pricing

Implement monthly price compliance monitoring dashboard in SAP (ME2L/ME2M reports) and establish quarterly business review with Meridian Industrial US to track adherence and identify additional harmonization opportunities

plan.expected_impact: Harmonizing Cleveland plant pricing to best-plant rates will eliminate the 11.6% premium and generate $3,729,867 in annual savings.
kpis: Actual savings realized vs. $3,729,867 target (monthly tracking)
Price variance elimination: reduce Cleveland premium from 11.6% to 0% within 90 days
Info record compliance: 100% of 237 materials updated to harmonized pricing in SAP
Maverick buying rate: 0% POs issued outside corporate agreement post-implementation
risks: Meridian Industrial US may resist 11.6% price reduction for Cleveland; mitigation: emphasize volume consolidation and long-term partnership
Cleveland plant may have different material specifications or delivery requirements justifying higher pricing; mitigation: validate material equivalency during benchmark
SAP info record updates may be incomplete or delayed, allowing continued premium pricing; mitigation: implement hard blocks on old records
Cleveland buyers may circumvent controls via manual POs or alternative suppliers; mitigation: enforce source list and approval workflows
erp_actions: SAP ECC 6.0: Update purchasing info records (ME12) for 237 materials at Cleveland plant with harmonized pricing based on best-plant rates
SAP ECC 6.0: Create or update outline agreements (ME32K) for Meridian Industrial US reflecting corporate negotiated prices valid for Cleveland plant
SAP ECC 6.0: Establish source list entries (ME01) for Cleveland plant making Meridian mandatory supplier at new pricing; set fixed source indicator
SAP ECC 6.0: Apply deletion flag to legacy Cleveland local info records (ME12) to block usage of premium pricing
SAP ECC 6.0: Configure release strategy (ME28) for Cleveland POs >$5,000 requiring Category Manager approval to enforce compliance during transition
SAP ECC 6.0: Schedule monthly ME2L/ME2M reports for Cleveland plant filtered by Meridian Industrial US to monitor price compliance and PO volumes
